description: Classification of the renamed entries that the diff step reports between the annex in force before 2022-12-09 and the pinned annex, and of the two taxa that appear as one addition and one removal. The ministry's press release lists additions, removals and regrades only, so none of these entries is validated against it. Classified by the authors with AI assistance (v21 revision, 2026-09-26), keyed by the scientific name in the pinned annex. Classes: spelling = a Korean name or the spelling or ending of a scientific name changes, the taxon does not; subgenus = a subgenus is added in parentheses; nomenclatural = the same taxon under another name (genus transfer, new combination or change of rank of the same populations); concept = the designated unit changes (Korean populations reassigned to another species after a split, a species described for them, a re-identification, or a subspecies widened to its species). Accepted names checked against the GBIF Backbone on 2026-09-26. v1.0.6: optional field subclass. For spelling: korean_name_only (the scientific name is unchanged; the diff step reports the entry because it keys rows on the Korean and the scientific name together) or scientific_name_spelling (epithet ending, rank abbreviation). For nomenclatural: rank_change where the rank of the same populations changes (two entries).

Plecotus ognevi.note: Korean populations assigned to P. ognevi after the split of P. auritus

Dryophytes suweonensis.note: genus transfer; since v1.0.6 the IUCN relation is uncertain (southern populations described as D. flaviventris, Borzee et al. 2020)

Osmoderma caeleste.note: Korean populations re-identified as O. caeleste

Ellisella ceratophyta.note: re-identification under another genus and epithet

Leontopodium coreanum var. hallaisanense.note: species reduced to a variety; same populations

Kuhlhasseltia nakaiana.note: new combination at species rank; variety raised to species (change of rank)

Halenia coreana.note: Korean populations treated as a separate species

Arctous rubra.note: re-identification; the IUCN relation of A. rubra is uncertain in this release

Omphalotus guepiniiformis.note: the same fungus transferred to Omphalotus (GBIF Backbone: L. japonicus is a synonym of O. guepiniiformis); Korean name 화경버섯 -> 화경솔밭버섯

Nannophya koreana.note: the Korean populations described as a new species, N. koreana Bae, 2020 (Bae et al. 2020, J Species Res 9:1-10, doi:10.12651/JSR.2020.9.1.001); the unit narrows to Korea
